class.name: FlowStartNode
class.description: The start node is where the execution of a graph begins. It has no input ports and one flow output port, [code]out[/code]. [method FlowGraph.add_node] makes the first [FlowStartNode] added to a graph the start node of the graph ([member FlowGraph.start_node_id]) if none is set yet. A graph should have exactly one start node that is set as its start. At runtime the node does nothing and continues at [code]out[/code]. [method FlowGraphPlayback.start] and [method FlowGraphPlayer.play] begin at [member FlowGraph.start_node_id] unless another node id is given. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var start_id := graph.add_node(FlowStartNode.new()) [/gdscript] [csharp] int startId = graph.AddNode(new FlowStartNode()); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]
